[[File:Ancient_Sith_Bravis.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An individual donning Bravis Sith apparel, including a Bravis Sith Lightsaber containing a Bravis Sith Lightsaber Crystal]]
The '''Bravis Sith''' were a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were located in the [[Bravis system/Legends|Bravis system]]. They were considered ancient by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but some of their [[Sith apparel|attire]] still existed. [[Bravis Sith Lightsaber Crystal|Their]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] gave [[Bravis Sith Lightsaber|their]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] a sparkling effect.

==Behind the scenes==
The Bravis Sith were first mentioned in the description of the Ancient Bravis Sith gear in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]." Their lightsaber blades give the same sparkling effect as the [[Crimson Prowler Lightsaber Crystal]].
